test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who was the first woman chief secretary of Punjab?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vini Mahajan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vini Mahajan, a 1987-batch IAS officer, has been appointed as **Punjab's first woman Chief Secretary.**
 
• Vini Mahajan has replaced Karan Avtar Singh of the 1984 batch who was due to retire in August this year.
 
• Karan Avtar takes over as Special Chief Secretary, Governance Reforms.
 
• Mahajan is set to remain in the post until her retirement in October 2024.
 
• She has held prominent positions in Punjab and served in the Prime Minister’s Office during the tenure of Dr Manmohan Singh from 2005 to 2012.
 
• Her husband Dinkar Gupta is Punjab DGP.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **In News__**

 
• ** Chief minister Bhagwant Mann appointed, 1991-batch IAS officer A Venu Prasad as additional chief secretary to Punjab.(As of March 2022)**
